summary: Senseonics Holdings filed an 8-K reporting entry into an underwriting agreement for a public offering of 8 million common shares and 8 million pre-funded warrants at $5.00 per share, with an underwriter option for an additional 2.4 million shares. The offering is a routine capital raise under an existing shelf registration (S-3), not a special situation. Net proceeds are expected ~$74.7M (or ~$86M if option exercised). Closing expected May 4, 2026. No extraordinary event; merely an ordinary equity issuance without strategic, activist, or restructuring elements.
